4th Period.workingNow: Learning table tags and adding a table to your About Me page.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: A complete About Me page (copied from the Example file) with header/body structure, formatted favorites text, at least one resized image with a caption, and a table.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can build a simple table so that I can organize information on my page in rows and columns.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.13 — Create prototypes using structured code, organized into separate linked pages, to fulfill a design requirement.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.6 — Reading closely and explaining orally how an author uses language to support ideas.
agenda: I do: model a basic <table> with rows and cells (7 min)
We do: build one row together (5 min)
You do: self-paced — add a table to your page (20 min)
Exit Ticket: what's inside a <tr> vs. a <td>? (3 min)
4th Period.connections: You've built structure, text, and images — tables are the last new tag this week. Tomorrow we put everything together and finish the page. (Self-paced today so MAP Testing pull-outs can rejoin smoothly.)
